name: Mixed HI/EN vendor review — management approval needed
transcript:
[00:00:07] Singh: Good morning. We have gone through your cloud services proposal in detail.
[00:00:14] Provider: Good morning Singh ji. We hope it addresses your requirements.
[00:00:19] Singh: Technically it is very good. But yeh decision akele nahi le sakta. Board se approve karwana padega. Dekhte hain kya hota hai.
[00:00:30] Provider: Understood. When does the board typically meet?
[00:00:35] Singh: Next month mein meeting hai. Upar se confirm hone ke baad aapko bata denge. Abhi kuch commit nahi kar sakta.
[00:00:45] Provider: That is completely fine. Would it help if we prepared an executive summary tailored for your board presentation?
[00:00:53] Singh: Haan, that would be very useful. Ek slide deck bhi banana padega unke liye.
[00:01:01] Provider: We will prepare a board-ready executive summary and slide deck. Can you send it by next Friday?
[00:01:08] Singh: Haan, Friday tak bhej do. Main next week ke andar apni team ko brief kar deta hoon.
[00:01:16] Provider: Perfect. We will send the executive summary and deck by next Friday.

summary: Singh found the proposal technically strong but requires board approval before committing.
The board meeting is next month; no commitment possible until then.
Provider will send an executive summary and slide deck by next Friday to support the board presentation.

action_items.task: Prepare and send executive summary and slide deck
Brief internal team and prepare board presentation
